Description: Moderated comments for Umbraco 17. Visitors send a name, an optional email and a plain-text comment. Comments wait for approval by default, and only approved ones show. Drop one view component under a post. It works without JavaScript. A honeypot, a minimum time on the form, a per-IP rate limit and length limits keep spam down. Editors approve, mark spam or delete from a dashboard in the Content section. Free and MIT licensed.
